subject: Three distinct evidence sources—interview speech bubbles, observation checklist, survey chart—feed an anonymous persona profile card, which connects to one UI design decision on a small screen. Solid links indicate evidence; one faint dashed unsupported assumption branches away. Make the evidence-to-persona-to-design chain unmistakable.
alt: Interviste, osservazione e questionari collegati a una persona e a una decisione di interfaccia.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: a finished raster teaching illustration for a university Slidev deck, displayed beside native text. It must make the concept understandable.
Style family: the provided image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its clean contemporary 2D editorial contours, simple matte fills, rounded corners, restrained geometric perspective and natural simplified figures. Use overlap for depth. Draw a NEW composition suited to the specified teaching concept. Do not copy the reference's people, table or objects unless requested.
Composition: a complete airy landscape scene, approximately 3:2. Large readable shapes and clear relationships, generous margins, no cropping. Diagrams use precise geometry and clean connectors, with no unnecessary characters. Avoid tiny details.
Background: genuine alpha transparency outside the actual illustration. Opaque white can appear within papers, interfaces and intentional bounded diagram surfaces. No full-canvas colored backdrop, clouds, vignette, blur, glow, drop shadows, outer border or enclosing card.
Constraints: no grain, textures, shaded 3D, gradients, photorealism, sketches, decorative sparks or ornamental foliage. No lettering, words or numbers except the exact text explicitly requested in the subject. Keep the image calm, explanatory and coordinated with the reference.
Palette: Tailwind indigo/lime: indigo-950 #1E1A4D fine outlines, indigo-800 #372AAC structural details, indigo-100 #E0E7FF and lime-100 #ECFCCA light fills, white paper/interface surfaces; small lime-300 #BBF451 selected details. No amber, red, orange or blue outside this indigo family.
Subject and semantic invariants: Three distinct evidence sources—interview speech bubbles, observation checklist, survey chart—feed an anonymous persona profile card, which connects to one UI design decision on a small screen. Solid links indicate evidence; one faint dashed unsupported assumption branches away. Make the evidence-to-persona-to-design chain unmistakable.
The teaching caption, not to draw: Interviste, osservazione e questionari collegati a una persona e a una decisione di interfaccia.
The relationships and the specific comparison matter more than decorative appeal.
